_doc: Session-judged anchors for cells the re-anchor engine cannot bind deterministically (scan picks are leads, never anchors). Every id is an in-force register row checked on the date; the engine refuses a gated or unknown id. Keyed dir|slug|variant|analyte (variant * = all).

cat4-compiled|fresh-fruit|_|iAs.why: no in-force sovereign iAs ML for fresh fruit; bounded by tAs (Paraguay 300)

cat4-compiled|fresh-fruit|_|tHg.why: no fruit-specific tHg ML in force; Thailand MoPH 414/2020 general-food row governs (GB fresh vegetables 10 is not fruit)

cat4-compiled|fruit-snacks|_|Pb.why: fruit purees, leathers and jams are fruit products under GB 2762-2025 Table 1 (raise 100→200, held)

cat4-compiled|fruit-snacks|_|Cd.label: read-across from the GB 2762-2025 fresh-fruit cadmium maximum level (50 ug/kg): no sovereign sets a cadmium level for fruit snacks, and the fresh-fruit level is the source-commodity cell

cat4-compiled|dried-fruit|_|Cd.label: read-across from the GB 2762-2025 fresh-fruit cadmium maximum level (50 ug/kg) applied to the dried product as sold; drying concentrates the fruit, so the fresh-fruit level is at least as protective on the dried basis

cat4-compiled|dried-fruit|_|Pb.why: dried fruit is a fruit product under GB 2762-2025 (raise 100→200, held)
